title: Crohn's disease healed after the 2007 orb encounter

tellings.quote: And then my Crohn's was gone. I had no [music] more sickness.
Because on the one hand you were cured of Crohn's disease
tellings.difference: Told by the host rather than by Chris, and puts the event in January 2007.
tellings.link_reason: Both say Chris's Crohn's disease was cured after the 2007 encounter in North Carolina. The missing-time story is a wider account of the whole night.

as_told.title: Chris cured of Crohn's disease after the January 2007 event

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe says that after an encounter with glowing orbs of light in North Carolina in 2007, his Crohn's disease, a long-lasting and painful illness of the gut, simply went away. Bledsoe tells this himself, as the person it happened to. In his words, "my Crohn's was gone," and he had "no more sickness." Michels repeats it during the same conversation, saying that on the one hand Bledsoe was cured of Crohn's. Michels places the encounter in January 2007. The two are not separate witnesses, since Michels is echoing what Bledsoe has told him. It matters to them because it would mean the encounter did something real to his body, a healing he links to the orbs.
